title: A declared name is one edit away from `sentry-sdk`
description: Pipfile declares a declared requirement name in Pipfile within one edit of `sentry-sdk`. Pip resolves these names against the configured index, so a name that only looks like the intended project delivers whatever that other project publishes. The name this rule expects is `sentry-sdk`.
remediation: Confirm the intended name against the package documentation the project already trusts and pin the declaration to that exact name; a name that is one edit away from a widely used package is a typo until the project can show it published the name itself. If the declaration was meant to be `sentry-sdk`, correct it to that exact spelling.
limitation: It compares declared names with `sentry-sdk` by Levenshtein distance of one and reports a name that is not `sentry-sdk` itself; it cannot tell whether the similarly spelled package exists, who publishes it, whether it is malicious, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
